adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts the new logic collects teamDestinationCalendars by pushing each team member's user.destinationCalendar for COLLECTIVE team events (users.slice(1) loop) and then appends them into evt.destinationCalendar via evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars). There is no deduplication by calendar id/externalId/credentialId. In EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents, it now iterates `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and, when `destination.credentialId` is present, calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` for each entry. Therefore, if multiple team members reference the same DestinationCalendar (shared team calendar), the same credentialId/externalId pair can appear multiple times in evt.destinationCalendar, leading to multiple createEvent calls and duplicate calendar events on that same calendar.
